title: GridLock Remote Target Configuration (remote.toml)
description: Configuration preset for attaching GridLock to single or multi-rank gdbserver and QEMU gdbstub targets.

version.description: Schema version of the remote.toml file (must be 1).

name.description: Human-readable preset label shown in validation status.

endpoints.description: Single host:port, port range (host:start..end), comma-separated list, or array of host:port strings.

symbol_binary.description: Optional path to local unstripped ELF executable with DWARF debug symbols.

gdb_binary.description: Host GDB executable name or path (for example gdb, gdb-multiarch, aarch64-linux-gnu-gdb).

protocol_mode.description: GDB/MI -target-select protocol mode: remote or extended-remote.

auto_connect.description: Reserved flag indicating whether automated workflows may connect immediately on import.

substitute.description: Optional GDB source path substitution rules (set substitute-path <from> <to>).

from.description: Compilation directory prefix embedded in remote target DWARF info.

to.description: Corresponding local host source directory prefix.
